rationale: Jonathan and Udula both work across machine learning and robotics, with complementary expertise that could fuel collaboration. Jonathan brings recent graduate-level depth in ML research, NLP, and robotics manipulation (TensorFlow, PyTorch), while Udula contributes production ML infrastructure experience and systems programming (C++). Their shared Python and TypeScript stack, combined with Jonathan's hackathon project track record and Udula's early-stage startup interest, make them well-positioned to explore ideas together.
intro_message: Jonathan Chong, meet Udula Abeykoon — you both build in ML and robotics, and your research-to-production skill sets complement each other well.
